items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 1:1
items.html: (To the question) Every degree receives only from its immediate upper one, and ZA is the upper one of Malchut; therefore she cannot receive anything except from ZA. (Item 2).
